## Primary comparison: L_trel_gate vs strong baseline A_rgb (LOSO, clean)

- Baseline chosen by validation WER from pool: A_rgb 76.4, G_concat 77.6, I_xattn 81.3
- Seed-averaged corpus WER: proposed 84.86 vs baseline 83.98; difference +0.88 pts, 95% sentence-cluster bootstrap CI [-1.18, +2.93]
- Relative WER reduction -1.1% (95% CI [-3.6, +1.4])
- Paired approximate-randomisation test (sequences, 663 items): p = 0.2999
- Per-signer differences: S1 -4.3, S2 +0.2, S3 +5.9, S4 +5.2, S5 -4.5, S6 +2.9, S7 +1.0; exact sign-flip p = 0.547
- Seed level (3 seeds): 84.86 ± 2.37 vs 83.98 ± 1.10; mean diff +0.88 (95% CI [-4.89, +6.66]), Wilcoxon p = 0.7500, Cohen's d_z = 0.38, rank-biserial r = 0.33
